case-01.summary: Rear-ended on the elevated road; the payout was credited right after the assessment.
case-01.quote: “All done on my phone — I never visited a counter.”

case-02.summary: Stalled in flood water; the assessor came the same day, and the repairs and the claim were handled together.
case-02.quote: “I expected trouble with a flooded car, but the steps were clear.”

case-03.summary: A stone thrown up by the car ahead cracked the windscreen; own-damage cover paid for a factory glass replacement.
case-03.quote: “The new glass was original and I paid nothing upfront.”

case-04.summary: Scraped a parked car while reversing; compulsory cover paid the property damage within its limit.
case-04.quote: “Even a small claim was settled without hassle.”

case-05.summary: A breakdown left the car undrivable; the Basic plan's free tow and the repair bill were settled online.
case-05.quote: “The tow truck arrived 40 minutes after I called.”

case-06.summary: Someone scraped the car in our car park and drove off; own-damage cover paid out as agreed.
case-06.quote: “Paying out even when the other driver is gone is what mattered to me.”

case-07.summary: A passenger was hurt in a collision; passenger liability cover reimbursed the full medical bill.
case-07.quote: “Not having to pay the hospital first made a real difference.”

case-08.summary: The car was stolen and never recovered; theft cover paid out at the vehicle's actual value.
case-08.quote: “The payout followed the policy wording, with no back and forth.”

case-09.summary: Falling debris in a typhoon dented the door; the panel work and the claim were finished together.
case-09.quote: “I didn't have to pay the garage out of my own pocket.”

case-10.summary: A scooter hit the car from the side; liability cover paid the rider's medical costs and lost wages.
case-10.quote: “Both sides were handled at once, no running around.”
